notes.title: Shape Puzzle Update 1.2
notes.content:
With this update it will be easier to distinguish some nodes. I also added options to the settings menu to change the colour of nodes and pattern. By default you can just change the look of +/- nodes. When you unlock puzzle 60 and 80 you get new colours to customize the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283603/49f5e72e958bced97f15ef95d41ba98e5a897613.png[/img]

Within the first quarter of 2023 I will also release the shape puzzle soundtrack on steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1971020/Shape_Puzzle_Soundtrack/

Changelog

[list]
[*] Added to the settings menu a customization panel. To change the colour of nodes
[*] Added a hint to puzzle 61
[*] Changed the background of +/- nodes to be darker
[*] Added 1 new achievement
[*] Added more variation to endless mode puzzles
[/list]

notes.title: Endless mode update
notes.content:
With this update, I am adding the requested endless mode to the game. After you have played the first 60 puzzles of the normal mode, you get access to the endless mode. This is necessary because in normal mode you get to know each tile.


In addition, you will be rewarded with three new [b]Achievements[/b] for playing endless mode. In the Steam Achievements overview, you can also see how many puzzles you have already solved in Endless Mode and how many you need for the next Achievements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283603/7837abe72488f79dfc84d6717e3969c0dfe0b5de.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283603/c18d8d7e96e9ffe259ebb12086e76b33e73d85a3.png[/img]
[h2]Future Updates[/h2]
I plan to add at least [b]2 new tile types[/b] to the game, one of them will have the name "Inverter", guess what this tile will do in the comments. I also want to add options to [b]customise[/b] the game, i.e. change the general look of the tiles and the background. And of course I will add more variations to the [b]endless mode[/b] and improve the performance. I'm also working on settings for the endless mode. So you can choose whether you want to play difficult puzzles or not.

All upcoming work will be published in [b]Development Diaries[/b]. 

As always, feel free to give me feedback on the update or tell me what you still miss in the game.


Have a nice week


[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added endless mode
[*] Added three new achievements
[*] Added loading screen when starting the game
[*] Improved the performance when starting the game
[*] Improved the performance when loading complex puzzles
[/list]

notes.content:
In the upcoming version 1.1 of Shape Puzzle, I will add an endless mode to the game. The update will be released next week.

After this update 1.1 I will work on improvments of the [b]endless mode[/b], [b]performance [/b]and the [b]overall design[/b] of the game. I also found a way to test my game on MacOS so probalbly the game will be available for [b]MacOS [/b]soon too.

Feel free to leave feedback or to share some ideas what I can add to the game next.

notes.title: Release postponed
notes.content:
Hi all,

First of all, I would like to thank everyone who has already put Shape Puzzle on their wishlist. During SteamNextFest I received a lot of new feedback from players of the demo on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1942000/discussions/]Steam discussion page[/url] and on [url=https://twitter.com/DevmentStudio]Twitter[/url]. Therefore, I have decided to postpone the release to implement your feedback.

[h3]The release is not not today ([strike]20th June[/strike]). It is now saturday the [b]16th July[/b].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283603/02bac2bd2fffe541b6232ac1aa91e15729e296b5.png[/img]

Feel free to leave further feedback [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1942000/discussions/]Steam discussion page[/url] or contact me directly on [url=https://twitter.com/DevmentStudio]Twitter[/url].

If you haven't played the demo yet, you can still play it on Steam. The pogress will stay when you upgrade to the full game.

Have a good week!
